draft.workOrderTitle: Walking Trail Pole Light 9 Out at East Trail Intersection
draft.workOrderDescription: Inspect walking trail pole light 9 (asset LIGHT-009) at the east trail intersection. The fixture is reported out for two consecutive nights. The LED driver was replaced and dusk-to-dawn control verified on 2026-04-11. Check the photocell, driver, and circuit, and confirm whether adjacent fixtures on the same circuit are affected. Report any exposed wiring immediately.
draft.residentAcknowledgement: Thank you for reporting the trail light at the east intersection. Your request has been received and is being reviewed by the management team. A manager will confirm next steps shortly.
draft.managerSummary: The request appears to involve pole light LIGHT-009, which had driver and photocell work in April. There is no warranty on file, so routing defaults to the approved electrical vendor. Confirm whether other trail lights are also out before scheduling a single-fixture repair.
